notes.title: Rover Mechanic Simulator: Full Release is now available!
Rover Mechanic Simulator: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Dear Rover Mechanics!

We are excited to announce that Rover Mechanic Simulator is leaving Early Access next thursday, on 12th of November! 
Big update with many additional hours of tinkering is coming and it will introduce Curiosity Rover and Mars Helicopter Ingenuity to the game! 🤖 

[previewyoutube=lywJdc8vgP0;full][/previewyoutube]

But that’s not all! We will reveal the full list of changes on the launch day!

Livestream 
Next thursday we’ll also be holding a live stream, so make sure to join us on one of the channels below:

Community Group Challenge!
Remember that our Community Group Challenge is still on, make sure to participate! We’re getting close to reaching the 4th goal, which will unlock a new mini-game "Meteor Rush", which is our version of the classic arcade game "Asteroids"! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34825804/b42c83f3579bb7ebd463549457fcf33478eb2a26.png
